articles.summary: EPS of $1.53; $1.86 Excluding Notable Items1 1% Revenue Growth Reflects Strong Information Services Revenue Growth of 10% 21% Increase in Block Trading ADV and 37% Increase in Portfolio Trading ADV with Broad-Based Growth Across U.S. Credit, Emerging Markets and Eurobond Block ADVs Continued Focus on Expense Discipline MarketAxess Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: MKTX), the operator of a leading electronic trading platform for fixed-income securities, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. 3Q26 Select Financial and Operational Highlights (All comparisons vs 3Q25) Total revenues of $210.4 million increased 1% . Total commission revenue of $179.9 million was flat compared to the prior year. 6% growth in services revenue 2 to $30.5 million . 6% growth in revenue outside U.S. credit. Total trading average daily volume ("ADV") increased 13% , with growth across both credit and rates products, and market share gains in high yield and municipal bonds.
